notes:
What's new in 0.1.133:
- Podcasts: a show in the search results now opens to its list of episodes before you follow it, and you can play an episode from that list straight away, in the browser and in the phone app. Nothing is followed or saved and your place in a preview episode is not kept. An episode that is already playing keeps playing. The preview lasts 5 minutes from the last time you started an episode or moved around in it; after that, to start an episode, move around in it or pick it up after a dropped connection, open the show again or follow it. When a browser opens a show this way, this PC fetches it only from public internet addresses, never from your home network.
- Continue watching: a film you stopped part-way now shows in Continue watching even when the player could not tell this PC how long it is (some phones do this for some files). This PC now reads the length from the file itself, so the 95% "watched" mark, finishing and Up next also work for those phones. Mark watched and Clear still remove it.
- Sharing with another household: if this PC's Beebo sign-in changes while a share action is still running (accepting a share code, finding, leaving or watching a share, or a phone's guest pass), the old account's answer is dropped and a share code that was being checked is not used up.
- Link a TV: play links made for two TVs at the same moment now each stay with their own TV.
- Browser player: the quality label now shows the picture height you really get when a remembered quality is higher than the video itself.
- Audiobooks in the browser: a bookmark answer that arrives after you switched to another book no longer shows up in the new book.
- Watch history, music and phone uploads: a list that was still loading when you pressed Clear can no longer bring the cleared history back, and on the Music folder and phone upload screens a slow earlier answer can no longer replace a newer one.
- Library: file details (such as length and picture quality) that finish after the list changed now still reach the rows that are on screen, and no longer land on rows that replaced them.
- Storybook: the co-writer now waits up to 5 minutes for the local writing model to finish a story instead of giving up early, and a draft whose page numbers are zero, negative or fractions is refused instead of saving a book that cannot be paged through.
- Away-from-home check: a failed test that was not proven to come from outside your home no longer overrules what your router reported.
- QR codes: the spoken label of a QR picture now reads "&" as the word "and" instead of dropping it.
- Story Studio: a saved story with a prop change set after the end of its scene is now refused with an error, instead of keeping a change that would never play. A character who has left the stage no longer jumps back to the middle for a later action.
- Story Studio: a finished movie keeps its last part-frame instead of ending early; a shared line spoken by different characters uses each character's own voice; words in non-Latin alphabets get the same reading time and mouth movement as Latin words; a last spoken line makes the scene longer instead of being cut off; a preview that finishes after you picked another scene is ignored; scrubbing during a preview carries on from the chosen time; broken characters, sets and costumes are greyed out instead of offered; a cancelled playable-story export is no longer reported as finished; and a full disk while making voices or sound is reported instead of hidden.
- Library: the in-progress filter no longer shows things you have finished; grouping by first letter keeps titles in non-Latin alphabets in their own letter groups; opening every cast member on one show no longer leaves the next show's cast opened; a missing saved cast photo falls back to the TMDB photo before initials; a cover image that arrived cut short is no longer saved as a broken cover; movie art can use a poster in the movie's folder with a backdrop in the library's top folder; a collection with a damaged release date is treated as undated; and switching the details cache folder no longer shows details saved for the old folder.
- Search: when the movie or the TV show search fails but the other loads, the page now says so; document search finds accented letters and the Turkish dotted I typed from a plain keyboard; and a custom search site must now be a plain public web address (no user name, password, port number or home-network name).
- Live TV: a slow failed retry can no longer replace newer saved Live TV settings, and Set up ignores an older refresh that finishes after a newer one.
- Music and history: ending a song while it is paused no longer counts the part you did not hear; watched time and storage sizes are never shown below zero; and a damaged time now reads as never instead of "NaN days".
- Photos: damaged GPS data in a photo no longer becomes a believable but wrong map pin, and a map tile answer that is not an image is refused instead of being kept for a week.
- Live rooms and phone speakers: a camera change that finishes late can no longer replace your newer camera choice; a failed start with no message now shows a useful one; and a phone microphone answer from before you left the page, a crash or Stop can no longer turn the microphone on afterward.
- Walkie-talkie: a late Start answer can no longer restart the walkie after you pressed Stop, an older status answer can no longer hide a walkie you just started, and a guest whose sound connection fails is now disconnected instead of looking connected.
- Settings screens: in Add-ons, Appearance and Layout Share, Always on, the move-from-another-app wizard, Cinema, the connection wizard, Library folders, the convert-ahead queue, Search sites and the podcast helper page, a slow earlier answer can no longer replace a newer one. A double click can no longer answer the next confirmation box, a folder picker that finishes late can no longer replace the folder you chose after it, and a long layout-pack name no longer stops the chosen layout from working.
- Moving from another app and add-ons: an empty export file is refused before the wizard says it is ready; a zip archive now stops at its total size limit exactly; and an add-on whose program name differs only in capital letters is accepted.
- Streaming and connections: a send with no speed limit is no longer slowed down; a person who stops watching no longer lets a converted copy another person is still watching be cleared; a request for a capped video's details no longer reads the video, and a damaged byte range is refused; the movie and TV list addresses refuse write requests; the away-from-home check reports the real outside port your router gave; the status chip shows each home IPv4 address once; device names keep safe non-Latin letters; and a licence renewal check that crashes is retried like an internet outage instead of becoming an app problem.
- Help and announcements: "Call for help" now says it failed when Windows notifications are not available, instead of saying help was sent, and after Kitchen announcements are turned off an old message can no longer come back.
- Other fixes: intro detection really checks a file again when you ask for a new scan and no longer waits forever on a stuck converter; turning automatic subtitles off during a scan stops it adding a job, and made subtitles keep each timed line within the 7-second reading limit; the subtitle sweep reports a failed library read instead of an empty result, and a loudness measurement of an older version of a file can no longer replace the newer one; adding the same audiobook folder twice with different capital letters no longer lists it twice; a picture-frame presence check ends even if the PC clock is turned back; long phone upload names are cut without breaking a letter; and Beebo's own logs now also hide IPv6 addresses written in short form.
- Already fixed on Beebo's own servers since Nov 17, 2026, 6:39 PM Eastern, with no PC update needed: the TV cast receiver's link through Beebo gives up when a home PC never answers, keeps a newer handshake when an older one times out, and refuses a reply that is cut short or too big; and a walkie-talkie guest's sound connection closes cleanly when it fails.
- 0.1.132 was prepared but never published, so everything in it is part of this update.
- Windows only. The phone app and Beebo Auto are separate releases.
- Automated checks: the full Windows desktop test suite (2,099 test files) was run on this release's code just before its release notes were written: 2,053 files passed, 38 were skipped because they need tools or settings this PC does not have, or are switched off on purpose (not run), 3 failed only because of how the run was split and passed when run alone, and 5 fail the same way on the code this release was built from (two offline-page checks that now find the Google Cast script address on the player page, one Shared with you screen check, one translation check that runs out of memory, and one older player check whose copy of the player was not given a setting the new quality label added); those 5 are not changed by this release. The Nov 18 podcast and Continue watching fixes passed the 338 test files they touch. The first podcast preview change and the sharing and TV link changes each had two clear code reviews, and each other fix one. The signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. No person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 4bdb31365.
